title: Escarpment and Provision
author: Freya Vasquez
blurb: Ada Underhill, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
